run_replay_evaluation: run the replay evaluation CLI to visualize mocap data on a simulated hand model
run_load_model: run load_model with a checkpoint tag to load a GeoRT model for forward inference
run_ReplayMocap: run ReplayMocap with a data source to create a motion capture replay object
run_HandKinematicModel_build_from_config: run HandKinematicModel.build_from_config to build a hand kinematic model from a config dict
run_model_forward: run model.forward on mocap result data to compute target joint positions for the hand
